We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is the "compound at hand". We need to get carbon NMR? But aromatic carbons can be deduced from 13C NMR peaks in aromatic region (~110-160 ppm). Could use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get spectrum, then count peaks in aromatic region. That would be expensive but okay.

We have no other info. So we need to call carbon_nmr_spectra.
